text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each enriched blend's mean absolute error minus the enriched best single product's, main XGBoost settings. A linear stack weights the single-product XGBoost models' predictions, fitted per generator on the other folds. For UKV with ICON-EU, the XGBoost blend leads the linear stack by 0.01 points [−0.02, +0.04], not statistically significant at the 5% level (exploratory). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Post hoc: chosen after the first run's results, and fixed before the re-run that produced the numbers on this page. Every other row is exploratory.'
